data.title: Senior Python Developer
data.description:
Exp Must 7++ Location Kochi--Virtual Drive

16-Oct

About the Role

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Python Developer to design, develop, test, and support enterprise applications, REST APIs, microservices, automation solutions, and data-processing frameworks. The role will support the SAP IS-U Edge System transformation program and involve integration with enterprise, cloud, utility, and customer-service platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Develop scalable enterprise applications using Python.
  • Design and develop REST APIs and microservices using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
  • Build ETL/ELT pipelines, data-ingestion processes, transformation frameworks, and validation solutions.
  • Develop integrations with SAP IS-U, MDM, Salesforce, GIS, customer portals, reporting platforms, and middleware systems.
  • Create automation scripts for deployment, monitoring, environment management, and business workflows.
  • Develop cloud-native, containerized, and serverless applications.
  • Perform unit testing, integration testing, SIT, UAT, defect resolution, and regression testing.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and support automated deployments.
  • Optimize application, API, database, and data-processing performance.
  • Provide L2/L3 production support, root-cause analysis, deployment, cutover, and hypercare support.
  • Follow secure coding, authentication, authorization, and enterprise security standards.

Qualifications

Qualification bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field.

Experience Range7–12+ years, with strong expertise in Python, APIs, cloud-native development, data engineering, automation, and enterprise integrations.

Required Skills

  • Mandatory Skills7+ years of software development experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Python development experience.
  • Strong experience in enterprise application and API development.
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, microservices, databases, and system integrations.
  • Good knowledge of Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
  • Experience with data processing and ETL/ELT development.

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Data: Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, Databricks, Apache Spark.
  • Integration: GraphQL, JSON, XML, OAuth 2.0, JWT, Kafka, IBM MQ.
  • Databases: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis.
  • Cloud and DevOps: Microsoft Azure, Azure Functions, Azure App Services, AKS, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Terraform.
  • Reporting: Power BI and reporting automation.

Knowledge of SAP IS-U, utility billing, Meter Data Management, AMI, CIS, or meter-to-cash processes will be advantageous.

data.title: Senior Python Developer – Backend, AI/ML & RAG
data.description:
Senior Python Developer â€ Backend, AI/ML & RAG

Experience: 8+ years in software development, with strong Python backend expertise and hands-on experience delivering AI/ML applications.

About Team

Our team builds enterprise applications that combine robust backend engineering with AI-powered experiences. We develop intelligent assistants, knowledge-retrieval solutions, and workflow automation that integrate with enterprise platforms and services.

We are looking for a senior developer who can translate business requirements into secure, scalable applications, guide technical design, and take ownership from development through production support.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Python backend services, REST APIs, and service-to-service integrations.
  • Build AI-powered applications using large language models (LLMs), agent frameworks, and machine learning capabilities.
  • Develop end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines covering document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing, retrieval, and grounded response generation.
  • Implement prompt engineering, agent workflows, tool calling, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
  • Integrate enterprise knowledge sources and applications, including ITSM platforms, Confluence, SharePoint, and enterprise APIs.
  • Evaluate AI solutions for accuracy, groundedness, hallucinations, retrieval quality, latency, and cost.
  • Build automated functional, integration, regression, performance, and AI evaluation tests.
  • Lead technical design discussions and code reviews document architecture, APIs, and implementation decisions.
  • Troubleshoot complex application, API, integration, and production issues, and implement sustainable fixes.
  • Improve application performance, reliability, observability, and model/token efficiency.
  • Apply secure coding practices, access controls, privacy safeguards, and enterprise AI governance requirements.
  • Collaborate with product, QA, engineering, and business stakeholders to define requirements and delivery priorities.
  • Mentor engineers and improve development practices across the software development lifecycle.
  • Support production operations, dependency upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and application maintenance.

Mandatory Skills

  • Python and backend engineering: Strong hands-on Python expertise, including asynchronous programming, exception handling, testing, and maintainable application design.
  • API development: Experience building production APIs using FastAPI, Flask, Django, or a comparable framework strong understanding of authentication, authorization, versioning, and error handling.
  • Backend architecture: Experience designing scalable services, managing concurrency, and implementing caching, background processing, retries, and resilient integrations.
  • Data management: Strong SQL and relational database skills, with experience in data modelling, query optimisation, and application data access.
  • LLM application development: Hands-on experience integrating LLMs into applications, including prompt design, structured outputs, tool calling, and failure handling.
  • RAG and retrieval: Practical experience with embeddings, vector databases or vector search, chunking strategies, metadata filtering, and retrieval optimisation.
  • ML fundamentals: Understanding of model inference, data preparation, evaluation metrics, and the distinction between model quality and application performance.
  • AI evaluation: Ability to build repeatable evaluations for retrieval relevance, response quality, groundedness, latency, and cost.
  • Security and privacy: Experience protecting sensitive data, managing secrets, enforcing access controls, and addressing prompt injection and unsafe tool execution.
  • Production delivery: Experience with cloud deployment, containers, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
  • Technical leadership: Ability to lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and communicate technical decisions clearly.

Good to Have Skills

  • Experience with OCI or other major cloud platforms.
  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent tools.
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating MCP servers and clients.
  • Experience with hybrid search, reranking, query rewriting, and permission-aware enterprise retrieval.
  • Experience with Slack APIs, Jira Service Management, chatbots, and IT service-management workflows.
  • Familiarity with proactive support, ticket routing, and self-healing automation.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and distributed tracing.
  • Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, model adaptation or fine-tuning, and model-serving platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI auditability, data residency, and enterprise governance controls.

Self Assessment Questions

  1. Do I have 8+ years of software development experience, with strong hands-on expertise in Python backend development
  2. Can I independently design and build scalable APIs, backend services, and enterprise integrations
  3. Have I built AI/ML or LLM-powered applications with end-to-end RAG pipelines, including embeddings and vector search
  4. Can I test, secure, deploy, and support these applications in production while improving response quality, performance, and cost
  5. Am I comfortable owning technical delivery, leading design and code reviews, and mentoring engineers
